text:
maya: fyi - embeddings in eu-west1 showing a memory regression, ~4% error spike since 23:10 UTC. looks like kvcache pressure. proposing a hotfix + traffic shift to eu-west2 during the 23:45-00:15 UTC change window.
deploy-bot: Deploy request created: DR-2026-453. image: registry.redwood/internal/embeddings:v3.2.1-hotfix. canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
duncan: can we avoid a full region cutover? prefer gradual traffic shift + keep a fallback pool. what's the expected impact on latency?
selena: latency should be unchanged on eu-west2. the hotfix reduces mem churn by ~30% in perf tests. will keep previous image pinned for immediate rollback.
maya: rollback plan: immediately switch traffic back to pinned tag v3.2.0 if errors > 1% or p95 latency increases >200ms for 3 consecutive minutes. ops-bot: ack policy thresholds noted.
duncan: need expedited approvals from infra and platform leads. tagging @selena and @rana from infra. selena: i can approve from platform side.
selena: release notes draft: "embeddings: fix kvcache leak causing intermittent OOMs under high-prefix reuse. no model behavior change." link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DR-2026-453/notes
releasebot: release notes attached to DR-2026-453. changelog snippet: "v3.2.1-hotfix — kvcache mem stabilization"
duncan: confirm windows: 23:45 start, 23:50 canary, 00:00 ramp, complete by 00:10, monitoring hold until 00:25. all hands on deck during window.
maya: ops-runbook commands: 
```
# traffic shift to eu-west2 canary
deployctl rollout --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.1-hotfix --percent 5 --tag hotfix-2026-03-23
# rollback
deployctl rollback --cluster eu-west2 --svc embeddings --image v3.2.0
```
selena: +1 to commands. i'll watch telemetry and tracing.
duncan: ops-bot, please create a temp alert for p95 > 200ms and errors > 1% on embeddings-eu-west2.
ops-bot: Temporary alert created: ALRT-7892. Escalation: oncall -> infra-lead.
maya: decision needed: expedited approval from infra-lead @rana to start at 23:45. rana, can you greenlight?
rana: rana: i approve. keep canary at 5% for 5m, then 25% for 8m, then 100% if stable. ensure release notes posted to #release-notes after cutoff.
duncan: thanks. ops-bot: start deploy at 23:45 UTC.
ops-bot: Scheduled: DR-2026-453 will start at 23:45 UTC. Operators on call: maya, selena, duncan.
duncan: post-deploy checklist: confirm canary success, check kv cache hit ratio, p95, and error budget. i'll sign off at 00:12 if healthy.
maya: if any sigfaults or OOMs, immediate rollback. otherwise proceed with traffic ramp. :thumbsup:
selena: noted. posting release note to #release-notes now.
releasebot: Release note posted: "Embeddings v3.2.1-hotfix: kvcache stabilization". Link: https://console.redwood/releases/DR-2026-453
duncan: all set. thanks team.
maya: closing thread; will update with final status after hold window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
